name: Create an offset wordmark hero with links and split gradient background
query: Create a poster-like full-width hero pattern with a huge one-word brand mark, two small uppercase links on the right, and a hard-stop split color background.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-patterns and gather brand word, link labels, theme presets, text domain, and metadata
Step 2: Use a Cover block or full-width Group with a hard-stop gradient or two-tone color field
Step 3: Use oversized display type for a short wordmark without clipping important text
Step 4: Place secondary links in a small right-aligned cluster
Step 5: Preserve accessible reading order even when the visual layout is poster-like
Step 6: Escape and translate visible strings
Step 7: Verify mobile text fit and link readability
success_criteria: Uses a hard-stop split background or equivalent offset color field
Oversized wordmark is short, legible, and intentional
Secondary links are action-specific and not fake navigation if navigation blocks are required
Uses block-native layout and avoids custom CSS classes
No scripts, inline style tags, or raw untranslated strings
